verification_status: Verified - official Sciences Po Undergraduate College page fetched and read directly by researcher on 2026-08-21.
researcher_notes: DELIBERATELY RECORDED AS ONE DEGREE, NOT MANY. Sciences Po's Undergraduate College publishes 'one Bachelor of Arts', not a list of separately-named degree programmes. Students take two majors, one from each of two blocks quoted verbatim from the page: 'Block 1: Economics, Political Science - Comparative Politics, Political Science - Political Theory; Block 2: Law, History, Sociology'.
